home.title: The {month} league has started
home.lead: Every confirmed match until {end} counts. The top 3 in each division get the month's medal on their profile. On the 1st the table resets and the next one begins.
home.rulesShort: To make the podium: at least {min} matches in the month. You compete in the division you were in on the 1st, even if you move up or down later.
home.endsIn: {days, plural, =0 {Ends today} =1 {Ends tomorrow} other {Ends in # days}} · {end} at 23:59 (Brasília)

rules.title: Podium rules
rules.division: The one you were in on the 1st. Moving up or down during the month doesn't change where you compete.
rules.medals: One per place. Never two in the same spot.
rules.globalOnly: Only the Global League awards medals. Clan leagues record the podium in the league's history.

why.title: Monthly podium
why.division: Both compete in {division} in {month} (division on the 1st, even if rating changes during the month).
why.eligible: {count} matches this month · eligible for the podium
why.missing: {count, plural, =1 {1 match} other {# matches}} this month · {left, plural, =1 {1 more} other {# more}} to reach the minimum of {min}
why.label: Podium
why.rule1: At least {min} confirmed matches in the month.
why.rule2: You compete in the division you were in on the 1st.
why.rule3: Tiebreak: most wins → head-to-head this month → fewest matches → first to reach the score.
why.rule4: One medal per place. Only the Global League awards medals; clan leagues record the podium in their history.
